model_parameter_uncertainty.explanation: different advertised counts/scope may reflect different model configuration or training checkpoint; cannot assert total without tensor census

rationale: Inertly archiving a distinct pretrained checkpoint is separable from deserializing it; a publisher-maintained weights_only loader referencing same LFS object means unsafe older SDK should not automatically negate preservation eligibility.
hard_stops: No approved acquisition, local payload or user disk
All trained-state total and model package rights not independently closed
Secure pinned runtime wheel hashes and exact backend ABI unverified
No torch.load against the untrusted payload executed
HF download_checkpoint auto-fetch must be disabled for an offline restore
No default causal inference that an observed source hash gives user entitlement

test_design.H: Alternative NVIDIA code can read the same pinned model without old unsafe unpickler.
test_design.T: With legally acquired file in isolated no-network environment, verify SHA256 and run only vetted torch>=2.15.0 weights_only loader; n_min=1 checkpoint plus counterexample bad hash.
test_design.D: PASS if exact SHA, loader compatibility and no network, with complete licenses, user authorization and disk gate; FAIL on unsafe unpickler or mismatched SHA; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
test_design.C: Weights-only may fail due non-allowlisted checkpoint globals or patched ABI incompatibility.
test_design.U: Actual checkpoint tensor structure, user machine and licenses unknown; no numeric uncertainty model.
